name: Jeyas Installed Extensions Exporter
author: Jeyas

sections.description:
Jeyas Installed Extensions Exporter helps administrators create a CSV inventory of installed WordPress plugins.

Features

  • Export installed plugins to a CSV file.
  • Include plugin names and version numbers.
  • Show whether plugins are active or inactive.
  • Include plugin file paths and author information where available.
  • Open the CSV in Microsoft Excel or compatible spreadsheet applications.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through the WordPress admin dashboard, or upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Jeyas Installed Extensions Exporter from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Tools → Extensions List Exporter.
  4. Select the export button to download the CSV file.
sections.faq:
What file format is exported?

The plugin exports a CSV file that can be opened in Microsoft Excel and other spreadsheet applications.

Does the exporter change installed plugins?

No. It generates a report and does not install, activate, deactivate, or remove plugins.

Does the CSV replace a website backup?

No. The CSV is an inventory report, not a backup of plugin files, settings, or the website database.

short_description: Export installed WordPress plugin names, versions, statuses, file paths, and authors to an Excel-compatible CSV file.
